purpose: One executable comparison contract for the first delivered pipeline candidate: the Luke 2025-08-04 imec0 candidate is compared against the pre-existing legacy sort and the current rescue control on one named practical recovery failure and on preserved healthy intervals.
non_goals: This contract is not a comprehensive experiment framework and adds no new experiment.
It does not redefine or reopen the closed threshold Stage 2 experiment.
It invents no downstream endpoints; Step 6 takes those from actual analysis requirements.
It does not waive frozen experiment decisions, operator integrity checks, or the Phase E promotion criteria.

provenance.raw_voltage_note: traces_cached_seg0.raw has been deleted from preprocessed_recording/. Voltage evidence for a legacy-sort case is `unavailable`; that is an expected, permitted outcome that lowers conclusion strength and is never reconstructed.

provenance.production_graph: frozen rescue graph at 12/9; threshold Stage 2 ended in no_threshold_change

intervals.clock: seconds from the start of the selected imec0 stream (selected_start_sample = 0)

sealed_panel.policy: The sealed held-out panel is not consumed by this contract. No development window, healthy control interval or selected failure interval may fall inside a sealed window or its buffer.

healthy_control_intervals.purpose: Evaluation-only intervals on which healthy-interval preservation is measured. Never tuned on, never used to select the candidate.
healthy_control_intervals.selection_rule: From the pre-existing prospective-holdout candidate window motion table, keep the 120 s windows that do not intersect any sealed window expanded by the exclusion buffer, then take the lowest combined_motion_score in each session third; ties broken by earliest start_s. Selection uses pre-existing motion coordinates only and inspects no sorter output and no candidate result.

development_windows.purpose: The only intervals in which the candidate may be developed, tuned or inspected, and the only intervals a selected failure case may come from.
development_windows.derivation: Full selected stream [0, duration_s], minus every sealed window expanded by exclusion_buffer_s, minus the healthy control intervals. Recomputable from this file; the validator does not need it to be trusted.

output_root_rules: One local output root; never under /mnt and never under or over any input directory.
Atomic writes; existing incompatible outputs are refused; no automatic cache repair and no `latest run` discovery.
All outputs stay separate from accepted production results.

candidate.selected_in_step: Step 2 — chosen when the bounded amplitude-completeness audit ends

resolved_configuration.what_this_is: A retained-sort replay. The accepted rescue sort's spike times, original cluster labels and amplitudes are read back unchanged and re-grouped into identity families; no detection, template fitting or re-sorting happens. Nothing about the recording, the sort, or production QC is rewritten.

execution.clock: integer samples of the selected imec0 stream. Seconds are derived only as sample / recording.sampling_frequency_hz; the exported train keeps the original integer sample times and the original spike-row ids.

healthy_control.name: H1_third0_quiet
healthy_control.permitted_context: development windows [2820.0, 3120.0] and [3240.0, 4380.0] plus this arm's own declared healthy control interval; disjoint from every sealed window expanded by intervals.sealed_panel.exclusion_buffer_s

motion.rationale: No qualified-motion-field-v1 artifact exists for this recording. The only motion artifact on disk, motion/dredge-rigid-sidecar/estimate.npz, is a dredge-rigid-estimate-v1: it carries no qualification receipt, support/confidence grids or polarity declaration, and manufacturing one would be fabricating the qualification. This arm therefore runs with tissue depth == observed depth and is NOT motion-aware; the audit's finding of flat depth (2.81 um on this case) is why that is defensible here and it is recorded as a limitation, not a result.
motion.runner_rule: mode 'qualified_field' requires an existing qualified-motion-field-v1 whose sha256 matches the declared digest, loaded through pipeline.motion_coordinates.load_qualified_motion_field. A missing, unreadable or unqualified field is a refusal. Absent motion is NEVER silently substituted with zero displacement.

completeness_qc.unevaluable_policy: A family pooling original clusters whose median interval amplitudes differ by more than max_family_amplitude_scale_ratio has no defensible family-level amplitude measurement: report completeness `unevaluable`. `unevaluable` never passes the gate and a cleaner fit on pooled incompatible scales is never read as recovery.

labels.rule: A family identical to one original cluster keeps that cluster's original label. Any family built from a link is `unvalidated` until its own exported train passes the contamination and refractory checks; no track is assigned `good` by the runner.

settings.description: The resolved candidate configuration actually executed. execution_mode is retained_sort_replay because that is what the implementation does: it replays the retained rescue sort's arrays through identity linking, curation-equivalent labelling, QC and export. It was `resort` until 2026-09-06, which described a run nobody had written.

placeholder.resolved_configuration: non-empty object holding the parameters that will actually run, printed with digests before any work starts. Its internal shape belongs to whichever intervention Step 2 selects and is deliberately not fixed here.
placeholder.configuration_digest: sha256 hex over resolved_configuration as canonical JSON (sorted keys, no whitespace). The validator recomputes it and refuses a mismatch, so the digest cannot be copied from another run.
placeholder.inputs: the identities this candidate runs on, restricted to inputs this contract already declares: source_sort_id (a comparator sort_id) when execution_mode is retained_sort_replay, source_recording (a comparator source_recording, or recording.data_dir) when it is resort.
placeholder.reuse: pipeline/, testing/ladder_l1.py, testing/ladder_sorter.py, and the existing motion implementation for a motion candidate

settings.left_open_until_step_2: The parameter names and values inside resolved_configuration. They cannot be written down before a candidate is chosen, so they are hashed rather than schema-checked: opaque to the validator, but frozen by the contract digest and unchangeable once results exist.

dependency_requirements_resolved.description: The subset of unresolved_implementation_dependencies[].id that this particular candidate requires. Every id listed here must have status `resolved` before execution.

runtime_budget.basis: Existing evaluation-ladder tier budgets (docs/pipeline_improvement_plan.md §3). No new budget is created by this contract.
runtime_budget.note: L4 full-session scale runs only after Step 5's gates, under the existing L4 budget.

evaluation.reuse: The existing ladder, data, QC and frozen evaluation gates are reused unchanged.
evaluation.comparison_unit: the same supported neuron identity over the same physical-time interval; population-composition comparisons are reported separately
amplitude_completeness_semantics: QC amplitudes are full_st[kept_spikes][:, 2] in sorter-native units; amplitudes.npy is a different observable.
Historical QC fits 999 values in a nominal-1000 window; the exact-1000 calculation is explicitly versioned and both are retained.
A boundary-pinned (50%) fit is not a measurement of 50% and is never a biological lower bound.
Missing QC for a cluster is no_fit, never zero missingness.
evaluation.guardrails: Contamination/refractory guardrails and the common truth scores from the frozen gates; a hard integrity failure is fixed before any scientific interpretation.

acceptance.freeze_rule: Every field in required_before_execution is set from BASELINE evidence and frozen before any candidate result is inspected. `Better looking` or a statistically detectable tiny change is insufficient. Freezing writes acceptance_freeze.json into the output root; after any results file exists there, the acceptance block may not change. The freeze receipt binds the whole execution-defining contract (recording, comparators, intervals, output root, candidate, runtime budget, evaluation, the requirement registry and acceptance), not the acceptance block alone.

practical_failure.description: The named practical recovery failure this candidate must fix: rescue unit 37 over interval [6590.32, 6810.18] s where estimated missingness rises from 0.67% to 43.47% with a 30.2% amplitude drop and flat depth (2.81 um shift).

value_shape.name: short stable name
value_shape.sort_id: must equal the sort_id of a comparator declared in comparators (legacy_luke0804_v2v1_g0_imec0 | rescue_luke0804_v2v1_g0_imec0)
value_shape.cluster_id: integer cluster id, a value and never an array position; never a float or a string
value_shape.interval_s: [start_s, stop_s], which must lie inside one development window

completeness.unit: percentage points of estimated missing-spike percentage
completeness.value_shape: a finite, strictly positive number in the declared unit: the smallest improvement that would justify adoption
completeness.comparison: same cluster, same physical-time interval, candidate versus the named baseline
completeness.decision_rule: PASS requires baseline_missing_pct - candidate_missing_pct >= 20.0 percentage points for the named cluster (baseline) versus the family carrying it (candidate), over the named failure interval, both measured from full_st[kept_spikes][:, 2] with production's historical window indexing. An `unevaluable` completeness endpoint -- including one declared because the family pools incompatible cluster amplitude scales -- is not a PASS.

identity.unit: fraction of baseline reference train retained under a supported same-neuron link
identity.value_shape: a finite number in (0, 1]: the lowest retained fraction that still counts as the same neuron surviving the intervention
identity.comparison: supported same-neuron comparison over the failure interval; ambiguous links stay separate
identity.decision_rule: PASS requires retained_fraction >= 0.8, where retained_fraction is the fraction of the baseline reference train's events inside the failure interval that the candidate assigns to the single family carrying that neuron. This is an absolute level reached by the candidate's own train, NOT a difference against a baseline that is 1.0 by construction: read as a minimum_improvement the gate would have been unsatisfiable.
identity.clarified_why: 0.8 was labelled minimum_improvement but read as a retention floor. The contract was not yet frozen and no results existed, so the label was corrected rather than reinterpreted after the fact; the number 0.8 and its source are unchanged.

contamination.unit: maximum allowed increase in refractory-violation fraction on actual train used downstream
contamination.value_shape: a finite number >= 0 in the declared unit: the largest degradation that is still acceptable
contamination.comparison: candidate versus baseline on the same train, scored on the union actually used downstream, not on an anchor
contamination.decision_rule: PASS requires candidate_rvf - baseline_rvf <= 0.01, where rvf is the refractory-violation fraction of the train actually exported for downstream use over the failure interval, scored on the complete exported union and never on a clean anchor or a matched subset.

healthy_interval_preservation.unit: maximum allowed increase in estimated missing-spike percentage on healthy control intervals
healthy_interval_preservation.value_shape: a finite number >= 0 in the declared unit: the largest degradation that is still acceptable
healthy_interval_preservation.comparison: the healthy control intervals in intervals.healthy_control_intervals, candidate versus baseline
healthy_interval_preservation.set_from: baseline evidence on healthy control intervals H1, H2, H3
healthy_interval_preservation.decision_rule: PASS requires max over the declared healthy control intervals, over clusters measurable in both arms, of (candidate_missing_pct - baseline_missing_pct) <= 2.0 percentage points.

notes: Contract omissions block execution, not planning or the implementation of independent components: this file is authorable and reviewable while every required field is unset.
A single validator enforces the refusals; see testing/first_pipeline_candidate_contract.py.
